senses.gloss:
m. (-षः)
1 A ram.
2 The sign Aries.
3 A kind of drug.
f. (-षा)
A sort of small cardamom, brought from Guzerat. (-षी) An ewe.
E.
मिष to contend with, aff. अच्.

f. (-का)
A plant: see मेढ्रशुङ्गी.
E.
मेष a ram, विषाण a horn, कन् aff., fem. form.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A sort of poison.
f. (-ङ्गी)
A kind of creeping plant, (Asclepias geminata, &c.); see मेढ्रशृङ्गी.
E.
मेष a ram, and शृङ्ग horn.

m. (-मः)
A sort of Cassia, (C. tora.)
E.
मेष a ram, अक्षि the eye, and कुसुम a flower; which is compared to a sheep's eye; also analogous terms, as मेषलोचन, &c.; it is also read मेषाख्य and मेषाह्व, &c. as being named from the Meṣa or ram.

m. (-ण्डः)
INDRA.
E.
मेष a ram, and अण्ड the testicle.

m. (-लुः)
A sort of shrub, commonly Ververa or Berbera, (Ocimum pilosum.)
E.
मेष a ram, and आलु esculent root.

f. (-का)
An ewe.
E.
मेषी an ewe, कन् aff.
